title: TrackFlow Telemetry Event Catalog
description: Custom catalog validated by the rules in telemetry-plan.md. Every emitted event must satisfy the envelope and the event-specific allowlist.
validation_rules: Validate each emitted envelope against envelope.required and envelope.properties.
event_type must exist exactly once in events.
properties names must be a subset of the event allowlist and required names must be present.
Reject unknown envelope fields and unknown event properties.
Each event includes a concrete producer, emission moment, delivery mode and business justification.
